Its record-format list says 'round: 7', but the round-4 directory and the validator (rec.round must equal the round-N directory) need 4, so this record uses round 4. checks_run.expected: candidate_id sha256:d91f7152..., 3155 files, matching the manifest; the freeze commit holds only excluded metadata
checks_run.actual: HEAD is a76c2aed4 ('DG7: freeze round 4'). It adds the three round-4 assignments and the manifest, and changes stages.json, all excluded metadata. The candidate at the working tree and at --ref 471072d is sha256:d91f7152950ed7119b412db0135836c53a3f01e95300af32c86db367f0712e59, 3155 files. --diff gives matches true, with no added, removed or changed file, at 03:56Z and again at 04:14Z. All exits 0.

checks_run.procedure: Run the historical validators for DG6..DG1, the DG7 register check and the DG7 stage validation at HEAD. Re-run DG6 and DG1 with the real exit status captured. Then run all six historical validators with stages.json served in memory with one FIXING entry inserted before DG7's last REVIEWING entry (a control: the repository is not changed).
checks_run.command: for s in DG6 DG5 DG4 DG3 DG2 DG1; do node tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage $s; done; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --register DG7; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --stage DG7; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage DG6; echo exit=$?; (same DG1); for s in DG6..DG1; do node --import ./docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG7/domain/round-4/stages-fixing-patch.mjs tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage $s; echo exit=$?; done
checks_run.expected: PASS gate DGn (historical), exit 0 for DG6..DG1 (the assignment says these must pass); PASS register rules at DG7; --stage DG7 fails only on the missing gates/DG7.json before the audit
checks_run.actual: FAIL. Every historical validator prints 'FAIL gate DGn (historical) (1 problem) - stages.json: DG7 illegal transition REVIEWING -> REVIEWING'. The real exit status is 1 (validate-historical-exit.log, DG6 and DG1). Note: the 'exit=0' lines after the historical runs in validate.log are the exit status of the `tail` in my pipeline, not of the validator. The register lines there capture PIPESTATUS correctly. --register DG7 gives 'PASS register rules at DG7', exit 0. --stage DG7 gives 2 problems, exit 1: the same transition, plus gates/DG7.json not found (expected before the audit). Cause: the round-4 freeze commit appended REVIEWING directly after round 3's REVIEWING. The round-3 FAIL outcome and the repair period (D-276) were not recorded as FIXING. TRANSITIONS allows REVIEWING -> FIXING | VERIFYING | BLOCKED only. Control: with one FIXING entry inserted in memory, all six historical validators print PASS, exit 0, so this is the only cause. The orchestrator's prefreeze-r4 historical.log (PASS) ran before the freeze commit. Raised as F-DG7-922 (Medium, owner delivery-orchestrator). The fix is to stages.json only, which is outside the candidate, so it needs no new candidate.

No 'six' remains on any surface. The 'note' in the report about T-DG7-BE-A26 is informational: its handback exists under the same task. summary: FAIL on candidate sha256:d91f7152 (source 471072d, freeze commit a76c2aed4). All four round-3 findings are verified CLOSED_VERIFIED on this candidate. F-DG7-920 and F-DG7-960: a fresh protocol audit gives DG7 C3 = 7, and the register, release notes and known-limitations all say seven and name DO-D8 and FE-C3. F-DG7-921: A18's full-restart clause now rests on DO-D8B's T-B11 run, whose D9 stops and restarts PostgreSQL. The shipped drill fails D9 otherwise, and the drill code is unchanged. F-DG7-940: export-scope.test.ts passes 4/4 and kills mutant M4 (3/4 fail). The product code is unchanged since round 3 apart from the new test. About and the register render correctly in EN LTR and AR RTL with the round-4 register hash ec2b526ad703. New: F-DG7-922 (Medium, delivery-orchestrator): the round-4 freeze recorded DG7 REVIEWING -> REVIEWING in stages.json, so validate.mjs --historical DG6..DG1 and --stage DG7 fail. A control with one FIXING entry inserted in memory passes all six. The fix is to stages.json only, with no new candidate. The disclosed deviations DLV-011/012/024/030 (D-270/D-274, K11) are not treated as met and are left to the release-auditor.
